_comment: Findings that exist today and are not regressions of the change that introduced this audit. Recorded so the audit can fail on anything new; each entry is a shape that is visible in one color mode and gone in the other, and all of them come from the shared cScale section palette being weaker in light mode than in dark. Removing them needs a design decision about that palette. Run npm run audit:mermaid -- --strict for the full WCAG 1.4.11 picture.
